proposal.summary: An integer overflow at a buffer index in Exynos Mobile Processor 980 and 2100 can prevent the execution of requested services when triggered by a crafted application.
proposal.cwe_quote: An integer overflow at a buffer index

A.quote: can prevent the execution of requested services

proposal.recommended_next_step: Request from the vendor: (1) confirmation of affected firmware/SMR versions and devices, (2) a patched firmware or mitigations, (3) technical details/reproduction steps to assess exploitability (how a crafted application triggers the overflow and any required privileges), and (4) guidance for users/operators on mitigation.

evidence_quotes.quote: An integer overflow at a buffer index
can prevent the execution of requested services via a crafted application
